Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Ectoplasmic
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 188, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 294
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 3,000 gp (lesser), 11,000 gp (normal), 24,500 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that have full effect against incorporeal creatures, as though she were using the Ectoplasmic Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide 158).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Ectoplasmic Spell; Cost 1,500 gp (lesser), 5,500 gp (normal), 12,250 gp (greater)
